packageRules.description: The restic BINARY version pinned in ansible/reconcile/roles/backup. Bumps stay manual: restic is what every backup and every restore runs through. It is a github-releases pin, not an image, so no Trivy image scan applies -- the scanctl fs gate covers the repo side. The image pins in role defaults (scanctl.yml image_pins) are moved by the catena-admin update engine's repository job (catenahq/renovate engine-bump.yml), not by Renovate.

customManagers.description: Track restic binary version pinned in backup role defaults
